bundle.shortDescription: Independent containment verification for AI agents
bundle.longDescription: Kill Line watches an AI agent from outside its sandbox (eBPF on Linux, ETW on Windows), compares what it does against a containment policy, and records a forensic timeline and incident bundle when it crosses a boundary. Local only: no cloud, no account, no telemetry.
